description: Implementation of OS-specific functions for Windows, including file path retrieval, environment variable management, shared library handling, and debugger detection.

classes.name: Win32Library
classes.description: A class for handling Windows shared libraries, loading and symbol resolution.

methods.name: GetExecutablePath
methods.description: Returns the full path of the current executable.

methods.name: GetExecutableDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory containing the current executable.

methods.name: GetSharedLibraryExtension
methods.description: Returns the shared library extension for Windows ('dll').

methods.name: GetEnvironmentVar
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: GetPathSeparatorForEnvironmentVar
methods.description: Returns the path separator for environment variables (';').

methods.name: OpenSharedLibrary
methods.description: Loads a shared library and returns a handle.

methods.name: IsDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a directory.

methods.name: IsDebuggerAttached
methods.description: Checks if a debugger is attached.

methods.name: BreakDebugger
methods.description: Triggers a breakpoint if a debugger is attached.
